hemp.translation:
n. 大麻烟卷, 大麻, 麻类植物
[医] 大麻

hemp agrimony.translation: [植物]大麻叶泽兰 （Eupatorium cannabinum,产于欧洲）

hemp seed calculus.translation: [医] 大麻子样结石(草酸钙石)

hempel.translation: 亨佩尔(Walter, 1851-1916, 德国化学家)

hempel's column.translation: [化] 亨佩耳柱; 亨佩耳蒸馏柱

hempen.definition: s. having or resembling fibers especially fibers used in making cordage such as those of jute

hemphill.translation: [人名] [北爱尔兰人姓氏] 亨普希尔住所名称，来源于古英语，含义是“大麻+山”(hemp+hill); [地名] [美国] 亨普希尔

hemps.definition:
n. a plant fiber
n. any plant of the genus Cannabis; a coarse bushy annual with palmate leaves and clusters of small green flowers; yields tough fibers and narcotic drugs
n. a rope that is used by a hangman to execute persons who have been condemned to death by hanging

hempseed.translation: n. <俚>该处绞刑的人,无恶不做的人, 大麻籽(可作鸟食)

hempstead.translation: n. 亨普斯特德（美国地名）

hempy.translation: a. <苏>爱恶作剧的, 似麻的
